headline: Patch 0.30.4.0 (Module 1 Patch 14): new guild views
summary: The new guild views are now active, and Sap and Wizard Glyphs no longer cause unintended threat. Also fixes zone loading, character and NPC reloads while moving, and movement desync.

headline: Patch 0.30.3.2 (Module 1 Patch 13): class and tradeskill changes
summary: Class changes for nine classes, Rich Tin now skills Mining up to Iron, Woodworking caps at 300 at any level, and a Commerce skill-farming exploit is closed. Deep Gnome Bard is coming soon (internal testing) and overcharged scroll refunds go to your bank.

headline: Patch 0.30.2.9 (Module 1 Patch 12)
summary: Rebalanced coin/cash drop across a number of NPC types and fixed certain herbs missing spawning restrictions. Includes a Ranger Recuperate fix for a bug from the patch 0.30.3.2 reversion.

headline: Patch 0.30.2.8: Night Harbor reunited
summary: More fixes to economic exploits related to mispriced tradeskill items, and missing house crates brought back. Night Harbor has been reunited into one big zone.

headline: Patch 0.30.2.5: spell scroll pricing
summary: Spell scroll costs updated for a smoother ramp from levels 1-60 and a lower total cost to buy all. Purchasing Night Harbor East houses from the West realtor should now work.

headline: Patch 0.30.2.4: economy and stability fixes
summary: Fixed selling unsellable items for 0 copper, a possible client memory leak and zoning stuck in loading screens. Deep Beetle Eye prices raised to match Fire Beetle Eyes.

headline: Patch 0.30.2.1: Release Patch
summary: Module 1 Patch 4, the release patch: new login backgrounds, character creation camera adjustments, and NPC corpses above level 60 now last 28 minutes, up from 8.

headline: Necromancer, Ranger and Shadow Knight Deep Dives + Traits preview
summary: An overview of changes to the Necromancer, Ranger and Shadow Knight classes and a preview of Traits ahead of Early Access on Oct. 1. The initial class changes are in the October 1st launch build.

headline: Patch 0.30.2.0: Blind Midden opens
summary: Module 1 Patch 3 adds the initial Blind Midden zone and spawning, fixes an exploitable Rothold pathing bug and camping on lifts and boats, and adds Ail'Vorith content.

headline: Bard and Enchanter Deep Dives
summary: Beta Patch 0.30.0.0 includes the Bard and Enchanter Deep Dives, with much going on in preparation for Early Access.

headline: Patch 0.30.0.0: Early Access Patch + Module 1
summary: Most group buffs can now be bought from spell vendors instead of research, stealth detection is adjusted, and mesmerize overwriting now depends on spell duration.

headline: Get Ready for Early Access
summary: Early Access begins on October 1st. The team of 50 volunteers is prepping to enter this next phase.

headline: Elementalist & Paladin Deep Dives; the Deep goes live
summary: Beta Patch 0.29.0.0 includes the Elementalist and Paladin Deep Dives, and the Module 1 Deep zones went live, still very much under construction.

headline: Patch 0.29.0.0: The Deep unlocked
summary: The Deep (Module 1) is unlocked, with zones still in progress. Adds a forced solo challenge mode, and rotten corpse summoning moves to the opportunistic adventurer in all inns.
